name: creatable-select
title: Creatable select
description: Choose from a list or add a new entry: when nothing matches, a Create row appears as the last option, in single mode or as chips.
docs: onCreate(input) may be async and return the new option, or nothing to use the text itself. Enter takes the highlighted row, which is the Create row when it is all there is; Ctrl or Cmd with Enter always creates what was typed, and the Create row shows that shortcut when other rows are listed above it. While it runs, the Create row shows a spinner and the list cannot be touched; if it rejects, its message shows under the field and the typed text is kept. The new entry is chosen at once. normalise decides when two entries are the same (by default capitals and spaces at the ends do not count): a duplicate is never created, the existing one is chosen, and typing the name of something already chosen and pressing Enter says so instead of removing it. multiple turns the choice into removable chips, and Backspace in the empty search takes the last one back; taking a chip back with its own button leaves the focus on the next chip, else the one before it, else the field, and aria-invalid draws the destructive border around the whole chips field. messages replaces the words. Options have the shape of a Combobox option.
